items.difficulty_reason: Constructs M = Spec of the R-invariant functions on U, obtains f : X -> M from the quotient-compare correspondence, and proves the categorical quotient property in the category of affine schemes via the morphism-into-affine characterization plus the compare lemma; then separatedness (compose-after-separated), quasi-compactness (surjection-from-quasi-compact), universal closedness (integral over invariants, hence uc, transferred through the surjection), and universal bijectivity (|X| = |U|/|R| bijective plus the base-change invariants homeomorphism argument) giving universal homeomorphism; uniformity from the flat base-change invariants isomorphism.
